ruleDefinitions.name: Potential WWlib.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "wwlib.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\wwlib\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\"))))
